en: Cristiano Ronaldo Tops All-Time Ballon d'Or Fan Vote
Ronaldo Wins B.O.A.T.: A Paid Fan Vote, Not a New Ballon d'Or
Ronaldo's 2008 season tops the B.O.A.T. paid public vote. What the result means, how repeat entries worked and why his official Ballon d'Or tally stays five.

NVIDIA announces a planned $3 billion Meta equity investment and expanded Muse AI collaboration. What is confirmed, what is proposed and what comes next.
